description: Source code for the HttpssvcMetrics class and related functions, handling DNS metrics and HTTPS query statistics within the net namespace.

classes.name: HttpssvcMetrics
classes.description: Class for collecting and recording DNS and HTTPS resolution metrics, including resolve times and DNS response codes.

methods.name: TranslateDnsRcodeForHttpssvcExperiment
methods.description: Converts a DNS Rcode byte into an HttpssvcDnsRcode enum value for experiment analysis.

methods.name: HttpssvcMetrics
methods.description: Constructor initializing metrics collection, with a boolean indicating if the connection is secure.

methods.name: ~HttpssvcMetrics
methods.description: Destructor that triggers recording of collected metrics.

methods.name: SaveForAddressQuery
methods.description: Records the resolve time for an address query and marks disqualification if the Rcode indicates an error.

methods.name: SaveAddressQueryFailure
methods.description: Marks the metrics as disqualified due to a failed address query.

methods.name: SaveForHttps
methods.description: Stores HTTPS Rcode, record count, and resolve time, and determines if the response is parsable.

methods.name: BuildMetricName
methods.description: Constructs a metric name string based on query type, security, and other parameters.

methods.name: RecordMetrics
methods.description: Records collected metrics into histograms, including resolve times, ratios, and response codes.
